deltas.description: The cumulative inequality is a scoped proof component, not Theorem3.7 in isolation.
deltas.evidence: The audited binding supports accumulated-descent only; no witness, minimum or normalization appears.

deltas.description: The unnormalized proof includes h=0 and N=0 and does not require attainment.
deltas.evidence: For h=0 actual iterates are constant; for N=0 the sum is empty and both sides vanish. The telescope needs no lower bound. Negative h cannot generally be added: f(t)=t²/2 on R, beta=1, h=-1, x₀=1 and x_(k+1)=2x_k give at N=1 left=-1/2 and right=-3/2, so the proposed inequality fails.

source_review.evidence: Accepted as a correctly explained, scoped source-backed accumulated-descent proof component. This is not a verdict of literal source/Lean equivalence: the full Lean domain is a disclosed Hilbert/algebraic generalization. I read the two fresh reviewer packets only, their identical complete current module, their lessons, and validator schema; I independently checked the pinned primary source https://arxiv.org/html/2605.07006v1 at Definition1.12, S2 convention, S3 opening, Lemma3.1 and Theorem3.7. The proof distributes h/2, applies actual-step descent, uses the successor iterate identity and telescopes; the second theorem uses the true global minimum, positive normalization, a nonempty finite-average witness and the square-root implication. All scopes, constants and endpoints in the lessons agree with the module. The supplied compilation flag was not used as a substitute for semantic review; I did not rerun compilation or inspect dependencies beyond packet contents. No prior audit registry or previous verdicts were read.
